summary: The control node used the Unicode Sandwich: convert bytes to text at I/O borders, use text internally, convert back on output; to_text, to_bytes and to_native remain in use.
questions: Are to_text and to_bytes still needed now that Python 2 is gone?

answer_card.title: Unicode Sandwich
answer_card.answer_md: Convert incoming **bytes to text** at the borders (file/network I/O, env vars, some libraries), use **text** internally, and convert **back to bytes** when sending out. Ansible still uses `to_text`/`to_bytes`/`to_native` because they help in other unicode edge cases.
